title: 36 Hours in Majorca
abstract: There’s a quieter side to this breezy island off the coast of mainland Spain. So add mountain villages and inland drives to your to-do list.

title: 36 Hours in Oxford
abstract: Scholarly strolls and boozy cruises in the ultimate British college town.

title: 36 Hours of New York City Pride
abstract: This year’s host of WorldPride offers a calendar packed with activities. So dive right in, but don’t skip some of the lower-key options (and save room for Frito pie).

title: 36 Hours in Camden and Rockport, Maine (and Environs)
abstract: On the central coast of Maine, visitors will find a beguiling nexus of arts, dining and outdoor activities.
